subject: Re: FinSage POC - success criteria & kickoff
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jamie Park <jamie.park@finsage.com>, Arun Iyer <arun.iyer@finsage.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: FinSage POC - post-call recap & next steps

Hi Jamie / Arun,

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation and some promising alignment on the use case. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the POC moving: 

Summary of needs
- Integrate Redwood inference into FinSage scoring pipeline for real-time underwriting suggestions.
- Target volume: ~150–250 QPS peak, typical ~80 QPS.
- Latency target: p95 < 250ms.
- Data: 3 months of anonymized historical transactions + sample streaming API.

Proposed POC scope (attached: finsage_poc_plan_v1.pdf)
- 2-week staging validation (connectivity, data ingestion, inference validation)
- 3-week load/run validation with synthetic and replayed traffic (measure latency, throughput, consistency)
- Success criteria: (1) p95 latency < 250ms, (2) model quality A/B delta < 5% false positive change vs baseline, (3) stable 200 QPS sustained for 30m without errors

Owners / roles
- Redwood: Marcus (runtime & infra), Rishi (security/compliance), me for program coordination.
- FinSage: Jamie (product lead), Arun (engr lead), Lisa (procurement / contract)

Immediate next steps
1) Jamie/Arun: confirm success criteria above or propose edits by end of week.
2) Jamie: share (a) sample dataset + data schema, (b) IP allowlist or network constraints, and (c) contact for infra kickoff (who owns SFTP/keys).
3) Redwood: share PoC config & initial mutual action plan (attached mutual_action_plan.csv).

I copied Marcus and Rishi so they can jump in on any technical questions. Happy to hop on a quick follow-up call if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: finsage_poc_plan_v1.pdf, mutual_action_plan.csv

From: Jamie Park <jamie.park@finsage.com>

Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FinSage POC - post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Marissa — good notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

Success criteria adjustments
- Latency: agree on p95 < 250ms as target; can we add p50 and p99 capture for the report? (p50 goal < 80ms, p99 < 450ms)
- Quality: instead of absolute FP change, can we evaluate model drift vs baseline using AUC delta and a 0.03 threshold?

Data & access
- We'll provide a 2-week sample export (anonymized) by EOD Friday.
- For live replay/testing we need an architecture diagram of Redwood ingestion (do you support SFTP + API push?).
- Procurement (Lisa) will need the POC statement of work and an initial quote to approve for sandbox usage.

Timeline
- If we sign off on criteria this week, aim to kickoff staging next Monday (6/29). Does that work for your team?

cc'ing Lisa for procurement next steps.

Jamie
Head of Product, FinSage
jamie.park@finsage.com | +1 (617) 555-0890

Subject: FinSage POC - kickoff plan, owners & artifacts

Great — thanks Jamie. Aligning on the minor edits you suggested. Updated success criteria below and attached a lightweight PoC config (redwood_poc_config.yaml) with network options.

Updated success criteria (final for kickoff)
- Latency: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 250ms, p99 < 450ms (report all three).
- Quality: AUC delta vs baseline <= 0.03.
- Throughput: sustain 200 QPS for 30 minutes without errors.

Kickoff plan & dates
- Staging validation: Mon 6/29 — Fri 7/9 (connectivity, sample validation, basic inference checks)
- Load validation: Mon 7/12 — Fri 7/23 (throughput and stability)

Action owners
- Redwood runtime & infra: Marcus Lin (marcus.lin@redwood.com) — ingestion hooks, autoscaling config, load harness
- Redwood security & compliance: Rishi Malhotra (rishi.malhotra@redwood.com) — data handling, access controls, IP allowlist
- Redwood CS: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.com) — evaluation plan, report templates, weekly syncs
- FinSage: Jamie (product) & Arun (eng) — provide sample data, grant access, validate results

Attachments included: redwood_poc_config.yaml, finsage_poc_plan_v1.pdf, mutual_action_plan.csv

Lisa — can you share a short SOW/quote template and confirm who will own the procurement approval? If we can get greenlight by next Wednesday (7/1) we can start staging on 6/29 as proposed.

Marissa
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
